notes.title: Beta Update 2: Improved graphics & combat
notes.content:
This is the second major beta release, with the last one being late last year.

As a note your save files will be entirely compatible between versions at this time, primarily because such a system does not currently exist. 

The settings menu & control remapping have taken their leave at this time, but rest assured they will return in time. You may instead cycle through presets by clicking the cogwheel.

Otherwise, you will find a myriad of changes in this release compared to the last, some will be good and some will be bad, kindly inform me about what is bad.

As a note, the shop and blacksmith levels are unimplemented at this time, should you travel to either you make invoke the travel screen by finding the edge of the button on the top left of your screen. 

This release consists primarily of bug-fixes, graphical improvements and combat polish. As a reminder, nothing you see may be final at this stage. 

Feedback on overall difficulty, balance and game-play would be very welcome.

notes.title: Welcome to the Spectral Synergy Beta – A Multiverse Awaits!
notes.content:
Beta Access Available Now for Spectral Synergy: Realms Entwined!

Adventurers Unite!
The Beta phase for Spectral Synergy: Realms Entwined has officially commenced! This is your golden ticket to explore and enhance the game's multiverse before its final arrival.

Beta Access Insights:
Encounter a glitch? Make sure to report it straight away in our Bug Reports thread.
Your gameplay feedback is invaluable – we're all ears for your suggestions and insights.
Please note, Beta might be bumpy, but your crucial input is what will help us polish the game to perfection.

How to Submit Log Files:
If you're reporting a bug, please attach your log files to provide us with more details. You can locate these on:

Linux: /home/not-root/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Spectral Synergy- Realms Entwined/logs/ (Replace 'not-root' with your Linux username)
Microsoft Windows: C:\Users\not-root\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Spectral Synergy- Realms Entwined\logs\ (Replace 'not-root' with your Windows username)

Include the relevant log files when you post in the Bug Reports thread.

Platform Support:

Linux: Full support – our primary and most stable platform.
Microsoft Windows: Tenuous support – the game is available on Windows, but please be aware that our dedication to this platform is reserved due to philosophical differences with the OS's ecosystem.
macOS: Maybe

We're excited to see you bring the realms to life!

Warm regards,
Burner

The Spectral Synergy Team
